I am an old woman of 83 years, and my strength is not what it used to be. This rice plot is small, less than one hectare, and I have farmed this land for many years the way my parents taught me. I cannot afford the chemical fertilizers from the shop, and I have no money to hire many workers, so my children and grandchildren help me when they can. I will use the seeds I saved from last harvest, as I have always done, and trust the rains that come to Ruvuma.
